note: Re-judged 2026-09-30. TestRFC8950VPNIPv6NextHopCarriesZeroRD writes AFI 1 SAFI 128 with an IPv6 next hop into a 0xFF-filled buffer: Length 24 = zero RD + global, Length 48 = zero RD + global + zero RD + link-local, and parses back to the same addresses; observed red on a break of mpnlri.go::writeNextHops. {single-polarity: positive} valid: a sender-side encoding, the encoder takes no RD input, so no non-zero RD can be produced or refused. TestParseMPReachNLRI_VPNWithIPv6NextHop is the decode-side neighbour. The RFC8950-3-2 tag on TestMPReachNLRI_RoundTrip_VPN was dropped by the judge (D-15): it encodes an IPv4 VPN next hop (RFC 4364) on a zeroed buffer and asserts no clause of this row.
